messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing bit — two small asks: 1) precise UTC reset for dev sandbox credits, 2) can infra get a short-lived programmatic exemption for CI load tests?

Leah (CEO): Reset is 00:00 UTC on the 1st. We currently approve CI exemptions manually but roadmap H2 includes self-serve short-lived exemptions for org admins.

Sana (Finance): Adding: dev sandbox credits don't roll over today. Enterprises can request rollover in SOW. For exemptions >1M tokens/month we need finance review.

Riley (Platform): Technical sketch: short-lived test tokens (header X-Redwood-Test: yes) + auto-expire + audit logs. Auto-approve thresholds planned (e.g., <=100k tokens/day).

Priya: Perfect. Can we get the draft doc link + a follow-up slot on the eng sync to align on headers/metrics?

OpsBot: Draft doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pricing-exemptions (internal). (bot)

Leah (CEO): Product will share the pilot criteria next week and we'll open an RFC for the header/token shape. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Sana (Finance): I'll post the exact threshold proposal in #all-hands follow-up thread.

Priya: Thanks all — I'll track actions in a GH issue.
